reuse.why: Wraps the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend in one shared getOccurrenceAfterWeekendRule, and the budget template, getUpcomingDates and getNextDate all call it, replacing their inline skipWeekend ternaries.

duplication.why: The weekend decision now lives in one function; only the small 'daily needs about 7 candidates' look-ahead heuristic is repeated in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the date helpers, the old helper becomes private, and callers only consume the result.

scope.why: Every edit serves the daily-skip rule and its tests.

maintainability.why: The single rule function is clear; the null-aware loop bounds in createScheduleList are somewhat intricate, and the 7-candidate look-ahead is a heuristic constant written out at two sites.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No site calls the weekend adjustment directly any more; getDateWithSkippedWeekend is no longer exported.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated look-ahead count (frequency === 'daily' ? 7 : 1 in getNextDate, count * 7 in getUpcomingDates) is a small visible repetition, not a disguised one.

one_place.where: getOccurrenceAfterWeekendRule in shared/schedules.ts decides skip, move or keep for every path: getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and createScheduleList.
